settings.heading: Nourishing tradition, one pinni at a time
settings.text:
In Punjabi homes, the first cold morning of winter has a smell – atta slowly roasting in desi ghee, almonds being chopped, jaggery melting on the stove. That is where The Wholesome Pinni Co. began.

We still make every pinni and panjeeri by hand, in small batches, using the same family recipes: pure desi ghee, generous dry fruits and absolutely no shortcuts. Just honest, nourishing food that tastes like home.
